Visual audit round 2 2026-08-21 (finding 1, minor/overflow): on All Settings the floating States affordance sat on top of the last in-view row's value chip (audit crop: 'Text Size' at 1280, 'UI Scale' 100% at 760), hiding that setting's only displayed value. The affordance is position:fixed at the viewport's bottom-right with z-index 9000, so it hovers over whatever the column paints in that corner at EVERY scroll offset, not just at the end of the list — bottom padding does not fix it, because padding lives inside the scroll box and scrolls with the content, clearing only the very last row. Fix: shorten the scroll VIEWPORT. This concept scrolls the shell stage directly, so the concept CSS now sets .pm-stage{margin-bottom:48px} (34px button offset + 32px button height - 24px statusbar = 42px of real intrusion, plus 6px clearance). The band sits outside the scroll box, so rows that used to pass under the dot now scroll above it. The band paints the same var(--background) as .pm-shell and .c08-root (transparent alike under the glass themes), so the column reads unbroken down to the statusbar; a 22px linear-gradient mask on the stage fades the new scroll edge so the row it cuts reads as 'more below' instead of bisected. Three consequences handled: (i) the toast host is position:fixed inside the stage and a masked element becomes the containing block for fixed descendants, so concept JS re-parents #c08Toasts to <body> — measured afterwards at 560-720 x .. -866, i.e. still centred on the viewport with opacity 1; (ii) .c08-copy-bar's sticky offset moved from bottom:0 to bottom:22px so its buttons never dim at the scroll edge (measured at 950/1000/1100/1280 with a forced-overflow 700px-tall window: bar bottom 580 vs fade start 606, clear); (iii) .c08-drop's max-height went from min(58vh,560px) to min(58vh - 48px,512px) so a long result list still ends above the scroll edge on short windows (was clipped at 1280x700 before the trim, clear after). .c08-page's trailing padding dropped 72px -> 24px so the whitespace between the last row and the statusbar is unchanged at 72px total. Verified with a paint-level CDP probe: the drawer button and panel are forced pointer-events:none, then document.elementFromPoint hit-tests a 3px grid over the button's whole rect at every scroll offset of 10 routes x 760/1280/2500 — zero points resolve to an element inside .c08-root, and the stage's bottom edge measures 6px above the button's top edge everywhere. Negative control (margin-bottom overridden to 0) reproduces the defect at 121 grid points at 760 and 165 at 1280, all .c08-all-row, so the probe is not a no-op. Re-shot and inspected with Read at 900px height: All Settings at scroll-top (the audit's frame — the 'Text Size' 15 chip is fully legible and the dot sits below the scroll edge), mid-list and at the true end (friendly-dark + friendly-light + basic-dark at 1280, friendly-dark at 760), plus home at 1280 (basic-dark, friendly-light), home at 760 (friendly-dark), copy at 1280 and manager/m.providers at 1280. Finding gone; no route regressed.

Visual audit round 3 2026-08-21 (finding 2, minor/contrast): on the Copy route the primary Continue button painted its label with var(--background) — the PAGE ground, not an on-accent colour — so the two light faces whose --accent-primary is mid-luminance rendered near-white text on a light fill: glass-light 1.64:1 and friendly-light 1.74:1 measured in the audit shots, against 3.21/3.56:1 for the identical control in the dark faces. Two causes, both fixed. (i) INK: the concept now defines --c08-on-accent = color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-primary) 12%, #000) — a dark ink cut from each face's OWN accent — with retro-light and basic-light overridden to var(--surface-elevated) because their accents are deep blues that want the light ink. .c08-btn-primary and the accent-filled .c08-cat-tile-box tick both use it. Measured on the rendered pixels (pure-python-equivalent PNG decode + WCAG luminance, enabled state, label vs its own fill): retro-dark 12.82, friendly-dark 9.38, basic-dark 8.25, glass-dark 8.03, retro-light 7.89, basic-light 7.04, friendly-light 6.08, glass-light 4.86 — all eight clear 4.5:1. The category tick on the same fill measures 4.04-8.27:1. (ii) DISABLED: the audit shot caught the button in its disabled state, which was `opacity:.55` over the enabled skin; opacity composites the whole control toward the ground, so even with the corrected ink the label would still have measured ~2.3:1 in friendly-light. .c08-btn[disabled] is now painted from tokens instead — background var(--surface-alt), border var(--border), color var(--text-muted), no opacity — measured on the shipped shots at glass-light 8.05, basic-dark 6.91, retro-light 6.76, friendly-light 5.99, friendly-dark 5.50, retro-dark 5.10, basic-light 4.73, glass-dark 4.65. The three :hover rules gained :not([disabled]) so a disabled button cannot pick the hover skin back up.

Visual audit round 3 2026-08-21 (finding 1, minor/layout): on the Copy route at 760 the four-step wizard stepper wrapped 3+1 and left a chevron connector dangling at the end of row 1 pointing into empty space, while step 4 opened row 2 with no connector before it (audit measurement: chevron at x=638-640,y=311 in basic-light/dark; row 2 a single pill flush at the x=52 margin). Cause: connectors were siblings of the pills in one wrapping flex row, so a wrap could break the pair. Fix, both halves: (i) copyStepsHtml now emits each connector INSIDE the .c08-copy-step-cell of the step it leads into, so a connector can never be separated from its pill; (ii) below 1000px the connectors are dropped entirely rather than leading a wrapped row — the numbered pills carry the sequence. The 1000px breakpoint was chosen by measurement: with connectors shown, the single-row threshold is 768px friendly, 773px retro, 840px glass, 927px basic, so 1000px clears the widest face with room for font-metric drift (and matches the shell's own narrow breakpoint). Verified by driving the page in all eight themes at 760/900/1000/1100/1179/1181/1280/1400/2500: four cells at every cell, zero dangling connectors, zero row-leading connectors, and connectors present exactly when the row is unbroken.

Round 3c 2026-08-21 (definitive closing battery, intermittent): route-<case>-back-restores failed roughly half the time in the search suite — 'history.back() did not restore the query and its results'. Diagnosed by replaying the suite's own routeCase with the harness helpers (real CDP mouse click, real key events) plus page-side instrumentation of every PM2.route.go and hashchange. The routing was never at fault: after Back the hash and data-pm2-route were always correct (#/search/<q> / search/<q>), and a sample taken immediately after history.back() showed the restored dropdown with 20-24 visible [data-rid] results. They were then WIPED before the harness's next poll sample. The race: picking a result with a real mouse click moves focus out of .c08-search-wrap, which schedules the polite 120ms focusout close. chooseResult navigates in the same gesture, Back can land the search surface again inside those 120ms, and the stale timer then fired against the PREVIOUS (now detached) wrap — `wrap.contains(document.activeElement)` is false for a detached node, so the guard passed and it set ui.search.open=false and emptied the dropdown host that the restore had just filled. Whether the harness sampled before or after the timer decided pass/fail, which is why it looked like flake. Fix (deterministic, no timing dependence): the timer is now owned (ui.searchBlurTimer), re-scheduling cancels the previous one, openDest() cancels any pending close on EVERY navigation (a navigation decides the dropdown state, not a timer scheduled against the surface it replaced), and the callback refuses to act unless its wrap is still in the document AND is still the live active wrap. Evidence: an aggressive replay that calls history.back() the instant .pm2-located appears (no settle) failed 9/12 before the fix and 0/16 after it, across theme / api key / rate limits / providers. The polite close itself still works — verified by measurement: 24 results open, 0 after an outside click, 0 after Escape, and a result click still lands on setting/general.visual.theme. Then five consecutive full search-suite runs: 21/21 every time.
